nodes.notes: Receives { actionId, outcome: 'success'|'failure', providerMessageId?, providerResponse?, error?, retryable? } from Workflows 03/04/05.

nodes.name: Report Result To Backend
nodes.notes: ALL progression logic — next-step selection, delay calculation, retry/backoff, completing the run — happens inside the backend (see Backend/src/services/automation.service.ts). This node's only job is to report what happened and hand back whatever the backend decided next. No business workflow is ever encoded here.
